title: AI initiative targets 3m users this year

title: Anthropic’s artificial intelligence gave a false homicide tip to Philly police, triggering a meeting with the company
description: PHILADELPHIA — An artificial intelligence model operated by Anthropic submitted false information about an unsolved Philadelphia homicide to the police department’s public tip forum this summer, law enforcement officials said Friday.
